message.reasoning_content: We need to determine correct charge(s). Facts: illegal fundraising (collecting money from public with high interest promises, using factories as guarantee) – essentially illegal fundraising (非法吸收公众存款) or fraud? The prosecution says "使用诈骗方法非法集资" i.e., using fraud methods to illegally raise funds. In Chinese criminal law, there is a specific crime: “非法集资罪” (illegal fundraising) but often labeled as “非法吸收公众存款”. The correction lessons include: label 【非法吸收公众存款】 (not 诈骗). So we should label as illegal absorption of public deposits. Also maybe "诈骗" if they used fraud? But the correction says for similar cases they used illegal absorption. In earlier examples: multiple cases of similar facts (collecting from public with high interest) were labeled "非法吸收公众存款". So answer: [罪名]非法吸收公众存款<eoa>. No other crimes. So final JSON.
